endpoints.description: Server-sent events stream of job and project events, with a keep-alive every 15 seconds. Filter with `project_id`.
Health check: `healthy` or `degraded`, whether ComfyUI is up, its queue depth, whether FFmpeg is found and whether a GPU is available.
List the prompt-writing instructions (system prompts) the LLM steps use, with their override state.
Save the current text of an instruction as a named preset.
Load a named preset into an instruction.
One instruction's current text, its default and whether a project override is set.
Save an instruction override for a project or for all projects.
Remove an override and return to the built-in instruction.
List jobs, newest first. Filter with `project_id`, `status` and `type`.
One job: status (`queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `interrupted`), progress, result and error.
Cancel a queued or running job. A running ComfyUI render is interrupted.
The job's progress log. Pass `since` (a sequence number) to read only new lines.
Start a failed or interrupted job again. `resume: true` skips work that already finished.

Which LLM the API would use right now, for a project (`project_id`) or, with none, for a new project (your saved model defaults). For LM Studio this is the model that is loaded. The API never loads or switches a model.
Models the configured LLM provider offers. `provider` selects LM Studio, an own server or an API provider.
Send a short test request to the configured LLM runner and report whether it answers.
Free the memory held by the built-in LLM runners (clears their caches and the CUDA cache). It does not touch LM Studio.
API version (`v1`), pack version and update date, schema version and the list of capabilities (projects, scenes, prompts, videos, latents, post, face fix, pipelines, jobs, events).
Models, checkpoints and LoRAs installed in ComfyUI, grouped by type.
Supported image and video modes with their requirements and capabilities.
Song to final video in one job: create the project if needed, attach audio and lyrics, make the scenes, then run the full build.
List the saved color and tone adjustment presets.
Save a color and tone adjustment preset (`settings`).
List the available LUT (color look-up table) files.
Delete a LUT, grain or color preview file the API created.
Upload a LUT file (base64 `content` and `filename`).
List projects found in the allowed project roots. `root` limits the search to one root.
Create a project: folder, empty session seeded with your saved model defaults. Body: `name`, optional `template_from`.
Delete a project folder from disk. Needs `confirm` equal to the project id.

The project with its settings, scenes, audio, story and references. `include` picks some of those groups and/or top-level session keys by name (e.g. `audio_path`, `detected_tempo_bpm`, `flux_reference_builder`; API keys come back blank). A Builder session key the project has not saved yet comes back empty (`{}` for `flux_reference_builder`, `builder_story_layer` and `builder_storyboard_defaults`, otherwise `null`). A name that is not a Builder session key is a 400 that lists it.
Files in the project folder: images, videos, thumbnails, audio and final videos.
Attach the song: a file path (`audio_path`) or uploaded data (`audio_data`, `audio_name`). Saves the waveform peaks, beats and tempo.
Beat markers and detected tempo.
Replace the beat markers (`beats`) and tempo (`tempo_bpm`).
Create a silent audio track of a given `duration` instead of a song.
Waveform peaks for drawing the audio. `peaks` sets how many.
Copy a project to `new_name`. `options` chooses what to keep (scenes, mappings, notes, prompts, media).
Build a zip of the project for backup or sharing.
The project's lyrics text and the lyric text on each scene.
Set the lyrics (`lyrics_text`) or an SRT (`srt_text`). The text is the reference Line Mapping works from.
Time the lyrics against the song with the Stable-ts workflow in ComfyUI and save the timed lines.

Write MiniMax H3 reference-to-video prompts with the project's LLM for scenes that have none (`replace_existing`, `scene_ids`, `limit`). Each singing scene's prompt has its lyric in double quotes after 'sings the lyric line,'. Saves them on the scenes and in the Storyboard Builder's copy (`storyboard/storyboard.json` and the `prompts/` files). Needs a mapped character with an image on each scene. Each prompt is the Builder's full format: subject definitions tying `<Subject N>` to `<Picture N>`, summary, retention analysis, the shots, and the soundscape.
Write image or video prompts for many scenes (`kind`, `scope`, `run_mode`, `scene_ids`). Image prompts use each scene's notes, lyric and references.
Write scene concept prompts for the whole project with the LLM.
Write motion and camera notes for scenes with the LLM.
Characters, locations and the scene mappings.
Assign characters and locations to scenes by pattern (`random`, `rotate`, `blocks`, `unchanged`). `dry_run` previews.
Ask the project's LLM for filming locations from the lyrics and `style_theme` (LM Extract) and add them.
Create or update a location (name, description, optional image).

Read which characters, locations, ingredients and extras each scene uses. A scene maps to one location here. To see every reference a MiniMax scene can pick from, and the order it sends, use `GET /projects/{pid}/scenes/{sid}/minimax-references`.
Set which characters, locations, ingredients and extras each scene uses. Sending `subjects` or `locations` also turns on that "use reference" switch, as the Builder does.
Create or update a character (name, description, `reference_type`, voice, trigger phrase, `image`).
Delete a character or location (`kind` is `subjects` or `locations`) and its scene mappings.
Describe a character or location image with the project's LLM (Gemma Describe) and save the description.
List scenes. Filter with `has_image`, `has_prompt`, `has_video` and `status`.
Insert a scene (`position`, `ref_scene_id`, `duration`, `label`, `notes`, prompts). Later scene files are renumbered.
Apply several scene operations in one atomic change (`operations`).
Delete a scene. `ripple` closes the gap. Later scene files are renumbered.
One scene: timing, lyrics, story beat, prompts (including `minimax_h3_prompt`), approved image, rendered video with its thumbnail, and scene audio. Each file is `null` when it does not exist.

Change scene fields: `lyric_text` (sets `lyric_no_lip_sync` from the text unless you send it), `lyric_singers`, `story_beat`, prompts (`t2i_prompt`, `i2v_prompt`, `enhance_prompt`, `minimax_h3_prompt`, `minimax_h3_pass2_prompt`, `flux_prompt`, `nb_prompt`, `flow_gpt_prompt`, `ernie_t2i_prompt`), `minimax_h3_continuation_direction` (what a scene continued with `latent_continuation_masked` does after its first moments, one smooth movement, no cut), `minimax_h3_continuation_start_seconds` (second of that scene where the direction starts: 0.5 by default, at most half the scene, `null` resets), `notes`, `label`, `start`, `end`, `no_character_present`, `lyric_no_lip_sync`, or per-scene `use_scene_*` / `*_settings`. A field that cannot be patched returns a validation error that lists the supported fields, and nothing is saved.
Merge a scene with its neighbour (`with_direction`: previous or next). Lyrics are joined.

What the Video Builder's Choose MiniMax References button shows for a scene: `available` (every character, extra, location and ingredients sheet with an image, each with its `key`, whether the scene mapping already picks it, and its `image_number` when selected), `selected` (the order sent to MiniMax), `custom` (chosen by hand or following the scene mappings), `automatic_keys` and the `limits` (9 images, 8 choices when the scene image is Image 1).

Choose the ordered MiniMax references for a scene: `keys` is the list from `available` (for example `["subject:ava", "location:roof", "location:alley"]`, several locations are allowed), or `automatic: true` to follow the scene mappings again. Unknown or repeated keys and too many keys are refused with the allowed keys listed. _(If-Match)_
Move a scene to `start_time`. `ripple` shifts the others.

The context brief an outside agent needs to write a prompt itself: cast, cut plan and character budget (`kind`). A scene continued with `latent_continuation_masked` also gets a `continuation` block: `hold_seconds`, the scene's `direction` and the `rules` for writing it as the next moment of the previous scene's take.
Rewrite an existing scene prompt following an instruction.
Improve an existing scene prompt with the LLM.
Write one scene's image prompt with the LLM, from the scene's notes, lyric and references (`user_notes` overrides them).
Build a MiniMax prompt from shot descriptions you provide (`shots`, `mode`). `save` stores it. A reference-to-video prompt gets the same subject definitions and soundscape as `minimax-prompts`.
Check a MiniMax prompt against the length and format rules.
Write one scene's video prompt with the LLM (`mode`), from its image prompt, motion notes and references.
Write one scene's video prompt continuing from the previous scene's last frame, using the scene's own prompt, notes and references.
Set a prompt field directly (`t2i_prompt`, `i2v_prompt`, `minimax_h3_prompt`, ...). Body: `prompt`, `origin`.
Change a scene's length (`duration` or `end_time`). `ripple` shifts the others.
Split a scene at `at_time`. `clear_right_media` drops the media on the new right half. Lyrics follow their words.
Effective settings in every group, including all MiniMax H3 options.
Change settings by group, for example `{"minimax_h3": {"render_pass": "two_pass"}}`. Saved under the same keys the Video Builder uses.
Check the saved settings against the chosen video and image modes and report problems before rendering.
The saved story layer: idea, arc, brief.
Replace the saved story layer.

Save the Storyboard scene defaults (`defaults`: every key the Builder saves in `builder_storyboard_defaults`, e.g. video style, camera flow, motion speeds, cut frequency, short film planning, temporal and FX settings, plus `story_arc_detail`) and the story fields (`story`: every key of `builder_story_layer`, e.g. `enabled`, idea, strength, world style).

Write a story step with the project's LLM. `step` is `arc` (from the story idea), `brief` or `beats` (a beat per scene without one; `replace_existing`, `scene_ids`, `limit`). Each step also updates the Storyboard Builder's saved copy.
Compact status: scene counts, how many have images, prompts and videos, total duration.

Rebuild or extend the whole timeline from text. `mode` is `durations`, `ranges` or `markers`; `action` is `replace` or `append` (`append_start` sets where appended scenes begin). A line can end with the words for its scene, for example `12.5 --> 16.0 Hello darkness`. On `replace`, when no line carries words, the lyrics of the scenes being replaced move onto the new scenes by time, so they are not lost. Returns `scene_count`, `scenes_with_lyrics` and `lyrics` (`from_text`, `carried_over` or `none`).
Shift all beat markers by `offset_seconds`.
Remove gaps between scenes by moving later scenes earlier.
Merge scenes shorter than `min_scene_seconds` and cut scenes longer than `max_scene_seconds`. `dry_run` shows the plan only. Scenes with rendered video are left alone.

Make the timeline scenes from the lyrics, like Line Mapping: one scene per lyric line, short scenes merged and long ones split to fit `min_scene_seconds` and `max_scene_seconds`. Turns on the lyric lane.
Snap a scene edge to the nearest beat (`scene_id`, `edge`, `scope`).
Check the project is consistent: files exist, scene timing, references, settings.
List the project's final videos.
Generate images for many scenes.
Latent chain status for every scene (MiniMax continuity).
Scenes whose latent is out of date because an earlier scene changed.
Rebuild out-of-date latents in order.
Delete MiniMax scratch outputs that are no longer needed.
Index of the MiniMax scratch outputs per scene.
Run the first/last-frame (FLF) build for an existing project as one job.
Run the whole build for an existing project (prompts, images, videos, stitch) as one job.
Dry-run plan for the full build: steps, estimated GPU minutes and missing prerequisites.
Apply the project's post-processing settings to every scene video.
Enhance one anchor frame (`order`).
Run prepare, enhance, LTX and finalize automatically.
Estimate the work and GPU time to fix faces in a scene video.
Combine the fixed runs into the scene video.
Find the faces and prepare anchor frames.
Run the LTX face-fix pass for one run (`run_index`).
Remove the scene's image.
Set the scene image from a file (`source_path`) or upload (`image_data`).
Approve one generated image as the scene's image (`image_path`).
Take the scene image from a frame of a video (`source_video_path`).
Generate a scene image with ComfyUI.
Step through the scene's image history (`index` or `delta`).
Delete a scene's latent (`all`, `reindex`).
One scene's latent file and status.
Apply color and tone adjustments to a scene video.
Make a still preview of the adjustments on the scene.
Apply film grain to a scene video.
Make a still preview of film grain on the scene.
Apply a LUT to a scene video.
Make a still preview of a LUT on the scene.
Clear the scene's active video. Files stay on disk.
Match the opening colors of a scene video to the previous scene's last frame.
Recover a MiniMax pass-1 or pass-2 clip from the scratch folder.
Bring back a scene video from a backup or file (`source_path`).

Render one scene's video with ComfyUI (`mode`, e.g. `minimax_h3`). Trims to the exact timeline length and saves it as `video_NNNN-audio.mp4`. Set `audio_mode: built_in_audio` in the MiniMax settings for H3 voices and sound (Single or 2 Pass; 2 Pass Advanced needs input audio). With `continuity_mode: latent_continuation_masked` the previous scene must be rendered first (`PREDECESSOR_MISSING` otherwise); it works in Single and 2 Pass. When `continuity_prompt_from_last_frame` is also true, the scene's prompt is first written by the LLM from the previous scene's rendered final frame (the Video Builder's automatic prompt), saved on the scene, and then rendered. A `prompt` in `params` skips that.
Choose which take is the scene's active video (`source_path`).

List the scene's raw (untrimmed) renders, newest first, with length, frame count and whether the file still exists. Takes in a sibling scratch folder with the same project name are marked `other_folder`. Only renders made through the API are always kept: the Video Builder deletes its scratch renders after each render. Use `take` on the trim call.

Trim a scene video as a job. Name the source with `source_path` (default: the scene's current video) or with `take` (`latest` or an index from `video/takes`, the raw render, so the clip can start earlier or end later than the current one). `start` is seconds into the source; give `duration` (and `frames`), or `to_end: true` to end on the source's last frame. Records the new clip on the scene and keeps the old one in its video history.
Make a video from the scene images instead of rendered clips.
Join the scenes' videos into `FINAL_VIDEO.mp4` with the project audio.
Build the ComfyUI graph for a video `mode` and the given parameters without running it, to inspect what would be sent.
Render many scenes' videos one after another as a GPU job, and stitch them when asked.
Scan the project folder for rendered scene videos and thumbnails and re-link them to scenes.
Summary of the API job queue: running, queued and finished jobs.

Saved RefMods in models/refmods with their type (folder), kind, frame count, tokens and description. Filter with `folder` (for example `identity`). A project switched to the RefMod pipeline (`pipeline: refmod` in the MiniMax H3 settings) renders from these.

Every MiniMax H3 video setting that can be patched under the `minimax_h3` group: type, default, allowed values and limits. `continuity_mode` takes `latent_continuation_masked` (the previous scene's latent is protected at the start of the next, Single and 2 Pass), `latent_context_frames` takes 39, 90, 141 or 192 for it, and `location_transition_preset` takes `masked`.
